recentItems.title: PUTIN’S ARMY SUFFERS A CRUSHING DEFEAT: 1.5 MILLION invaders taken out!
recentItems.description:
There were 211 combat engagements on the front line in the past 24 hours, and total Russian military losses since the start of the full-scale invasion have exceeded 1.54 million.

Meanwhile, Russia continued to terrorize civilians. A strike on Zaporizhzhia killed one person and injured nine, while a morning shelling of Kharkiv’s suburbs injured three women.

As Russian attacks intensify, the UN Security Council will hold an emergency meeting this evening. At the same time, a Ukrainian delegation in the United States is negotiating urgent air-defense reinforcements.

recentItems.title: RUSSIA is deleting ALL NEWS about the PLAGUE! WHAT ARE THEY HIDING?
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian drones struck strategic targets in Russia’s Ryazan region: a machine-tool plant belonging to the enemy’s military-industrial complex and a large Yandex data center that provided computing power and supported the Kremlin’s military logistics.

Meanwhile, the NATO Military Committee arrived in Kyiv in full composition for talks on defense priorities, air-defense reinforcement, and the provision of long-range weapons.

At the same time, internal chaos is growing in Russia following the mysterious death of an employee at an anti-plague institute, after which around 200 people were urgently placed under medical supervision.

recentItems.title: “THE ENEMY TAKES EVERYTHING, BUT WE ARE HERE”: how KHERSON LIVES under 24/7 OCCUPIER FIRE?
recentItems.description:
Kherson in 2026 is a territory of iron human dignity, where every dawn begins not with coffee, but with scanning the horizon for enemy drones and artillery explosions! These are not just damaged facades, shattered windows, or broken streets — above all, these are incredible people who go to work every morning, fully aware that by evening their ordinary world could be shattered to pieces.

In the second part of the special edition of the project “Travel of Our Time,” we show the deep reality of a city on the front line that official briefings do not convey. You will see children whose playgrounds are set up right next to concrete shelters, and meet tireless volunteers who, as early as 4 a.m., rush to another deadly evacuation under enemy fire.

We seek the answer to the main question: what invisible force keeps Kherson residents in their home city, where there is not a single peaceful second? And what actually remains of a city when the enemy tries to destroy and loot literally everything — from infrastructure to memory?

recentItems.title: 5 MINES AND 3 DRONES — IT SURVIVED! Cobra II saved special forces, even after losing its wheels!
recentItems.description:
The Cobra II armored fighting vehicle of the Military Intelligence Agency special unit “Artan” has demonstrated phenomenal survivability: it withstood detonation on five anti-tank mines and three direct hits from FPV drones. Despite losing both front wheels, the armored capsule saved the lives of the crew and assault team, and the driver managed to drive the damaged vehicle out of the kill zone to safety.

In this episode, we present a field test drive of the legendary armored vehicle, break down its protection features, and show a dangerous moment during filming when the multi-tonne armored vehicle nearly flipped over on a sharp turn.
